title: Internet-Augmented Language Models through Few-Shot Prompting (FreshLLMs/FLARE)
description: Active retrieval — predict next sentence, retrieve if low confidence. Interleaves retrieval with generation rather than retrieve-once. More accurate for long-form generation.
authors: Jiang, Xu, Gao, Sun, Liu, Dwivedi-Yu, Yang, Callan, Neubig
